sources.access: Primary abstract and relevant indexed full-text passages inspected 2026-11-15; no new excavation or recalibration.

review.summary: Vatcha records a short principal Lapita occupation followed by evidence of later, less intensive coastal use.
review.limitations: The main ceramic phase ending does not establish complete or permanent abandonment of the coast.
review.discussion: Local evidence is not automatically the first settlement of the entire island group. Main Lapita occupation approximately 3000-2850 cal BP.
review.provenance: Independent source check 2026-11-15 using completed research reports as leads; original reports preserved.
